build_requirements.envelope: MVP allowed envelope only (amendment §10): operator-driven, local host, single-tenant, operator-trusted input. H-12 hard-blocks external use.
build_requirements.f59: one-shot ticket enforcement active on every dispatch
build_requirements.limits_table: REQUIRES the build-tagged TEST-ONLY reduced limits table, for the same reason as xit-dur-5: the continuation overflow terminal is statically unreachable under the production table
build_requirements.observer_boundary: the E3 record is written to the observer's own output root and presented to the evaluator together with that recorder identity (m-3 r4 §3.6); an agent-supplied record is non_applicable(observer-mismatch)
build_requirements.tool_dispatch_constant: the operator-ratified fixed 8-name tool-dispatch constant, served by exact-set equality (F55)

capture_requirements: the committed-snapshot projection carrying all four members
the parked UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_OUTCOME row for op1-a1
the non-zero exit status from a scripted surface invocation

n910.claim_ceiling: this is an accepted documented MVP limit; the exit claim may NOT read complete lane-2 coverage
n910.disposition: the provider loss is disclosed through m-10's UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_OUTCOME retirement mapped to the uncertain class; no m-3 sink record is authored for the loss cut, because no authoritative per-attempt DATA-P non-emission fact exists in the MVP

design_decision.analysis: runs.stop_reason is non-null ONLY when runs.state=FAILED via resume_frame_overflow or parked_unknown_capacity_exceeded, and it is NULL in every other state and on every other failure path. The cap terminal explicitly carries NO resume_action. Therefore resume_frame_overflow is the only construction that makes stop_reason and resume_action both non-null at a single grain (both on the runs record).
design_decision.coherence: the composition is causally natural rather than contrived: the accumulated uncertain entries from the provider loss are exactly what inflate the continuation frame past the bound.
design_decision.consequence: xit-op-1 is by construction a FAILURE-surface test — stop_reason and resume_action are both failure-only members, so the ratified predicate cannot be satisfied by a healthy run. This is a property of the ratified predicate, not a redesign of it.
design_decision.owner_fidelity_flag: m-10 owns the operator surface and MUST confirm this reading at owner-fidelity; if m-10 reads resume_action at turn grain instead, this record changes.
design_decision.question: which run state makes all four members simultaneously non-null?

clock.rule: every timestamp-bearing record takes epoch_start + (tick_ms * ordinal); no ambient wall clock is read

workspace_root.rule: created fresh per run; absolute path supplied at `run start`; workspace_root_id = lowercase-hex SHA-256 of the NFC-normalized realpath (m-10 producer-delta §5 recipe)

drive.note: the attempt lost to connector/DATA-P loss — m-8 BE-addendum row 9, no m-8 carrier at all
the continuation carrying the accumulated uncertain set, sized past the reduced bound

expected_shape.last_event: non-null — the most recent committed event on the projection
expected_shape.loudness: the run-terminal failure renders as a persistent unmissable alert on every surface entry, and scripted invocations receive a non-zero exit carrying the same fact — never a quiet status field
expected_shape.unknown_effects: non-empty — carries at least the UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_OUTCOME identity for op1-a1, surfaced as uncertain and never as settled_with_content

fault.cut_definition: Two pinned cuts in one run: (1) sever the DATA-P/connector channel while the m-9 worker is live, so the provider attempt parks UNKNOWN_PROVIDER_OUTCOME with no m-8 carrier emitted; (2) under the reduced limits table, the resulting continuation turn_open exceeds the bound, committing the run terminal.

negative_controls: any of the four members null or absent => FAIL
the terminal rendered as an ordinary status line rather than a loud alert => FAIL
the lost attempt surfaced as settled_with_content => FAIL
the operator surface offering any authority ingress (clearing a parked row, forging a disposition) => FAIL; no such ingress exists in the MVP
objective: The operator surface exposes {last_event, stop_reason, unknown_effects[], resume_action} all present and non-null on one committed-snapshot projection.
